senses.definition: A device on a wall or surface that shows what time it is.

examples.text: O relógio da sala está marcando três horas.
examples.translation: The living room clock shows three o'clock.
examples.emotion: observant and matter-of-fact, noting the time on the wall

senses.definition: A small timepiece worn on a strap around the wrist.

examples.text: Ele ganhou um relógio de pulso no aniversário.
examples.translation: He got a wristwatch for his birthday.
examples.emotion: pleased and showing off a new accessory

draftBefore.emotion: practical and attentive, checking the time to keep things moving
